subject.title: fix(coding-agent): isolate Codex CLI CODEX_HOME from OpenClaw OAuth in skill launch forms

question: Should the bundled coding-agent skill require a separately authenticated external `CODEX_HOME` for every manual Codex CLI launch?
rationale: The implementation is focused and proven, but it establishes user-facing credential ownership and recovery guidance across OpenClaw OAuth and Codex CLI, which repository policy reserves for explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Confirm isolated-home contract
options.body: Approve the separate external home and one-time login as the supported manual-launch boundary, then merge after refreshing the branch and docs gate.

options.title: Pause for managed launcher
options.body: Defer this documentation fix if maintainers instead want OpenClaw to provide a managed launcher that owns Codex-home creation and authentication.

recommendation.title: Confirm isolated-home contract
recommendation.body: Approve the separate external home and one-time login as the supported manual-launch boundary, then merge after refreshing the branch and docs gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged history on the bundled coding-agent skill and its launch-policy guidance.
